slides.texte_overlay:
How to text like
a confident man
Reply when you see it, not on a timer. Waiting three hours on purpose is a game, and games look insecure. Answer naturally when you're free, and get on with your day.
Make plans, don't just chat. "Want to grab a drink Thursday?" beats fifty messages of small talk. Confident men use texts to meet people, not to replace meeting them.
Keep messages short and clear. One idea per message, no walls of text, no five question marks. Simple, clean writing reads as calm and sure of yourself.
Don't double text after no reply. Send one message, then let it be. If they're interested, they'll answer. Respecting silence is a quiet sign of confidence.
Have something real to share. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a funny fact or story makes a text far more interesting than "wyd".
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A funny fact makes a text far more interesting than "wyd".

slides.texte_overlay: Use voice notes for warmth, texts for plans. A short voice message on a birthday or after a great evening feels personal, warm and far more memorable than any text.
Never argue by text. Tone gets lost and things escalate. "Let's talk about this tonight" is the most mature message you can send in a tense moment.
